evals.prompt: Fix the runbook in files/runbook.md so it follows task-doc structure: verb-led headings, one action per line, pointers with concept plus trigger, and a checkable done line.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten runbook with verb headings, split single-action lines, a triggered pointer, and a checkable done line with command plus expected result.
assertions: The output is a rewritten runbook, not a discussion of how to rewrite one
Every task heading starts with a verb, with no bare noun heading and no gerund task title
No bullet line holds two actions; fetch and confirm are split
The pointer names the concept plus its trigger instead of a bare See line
The procedure closes with a checkable done line naming the command plus its expected result
The output never closes with an adjective such as output looks correct

evals.prompt: Review the ADR in files/adr.md for pointer and link structure: concept-plus-trigger pointers, named-concept links with section and why, filenames out of the decision body, and bans paired with a positive target.
evals.expected_output: A revised ADR with triggered pointers, a Doc link carrying section and why, literals out of the decision body, and a positive target for the guardrail.
assertions: The output is a revised ADR or concrete rewritten lines, not general advice
No bare pointer without a trigger remains
The Doc link carries the section plus the why
Literal filenames, column names, or migration paths no longer sit in the decision body
The ban is paired with a positive target instead of a bare Do not copy

evals.prompt: The text in files/announcement.md is a release announcement that needs natural voice, not task structure. If this is outside instruct scope, leave the structure alone and say so instead of forcing procedure format.
evals.expected_output: No procedure restructuring; the response states the text is voice work outside instruct scope and leaves headings, pointers, and done lines off.
assertions: The output does not impose verb-led task headings on the announcement
The output does not add pointers or done lines to the announcement
The output states the text is voice work outside instruct scope or defers to humanize
The output does not invent deployment steps or procedures
